title: Brazilian Queso Bake
description: A simple and delicious Brazilian-inspired casserole that combines queso with tomatoes and baked to perfection.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine Less, Brazilian, Queso, and Tomatoes.
Mix well until all ingredients are fully incorporated.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Sprinkle Quick on top of the mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
